title: Learning to Inject: Automated Prompt Injection via Reinforcement Learning
reasoning: The paper is focused on the technical security vulnerability of prompt injection in LLM agents and proposes a reinforcement learning method to generate attacks. While it notes the discovery of an attack suffix ('allelujah') derived from liturgical texts and hypothesizes on linguistic patterns of compliance, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, theology, morals, or ethics.
